invariants.rationale: The method body returns records.collectAsList(), so result is exactly that.
records.collectAsList() never returns null; it returns an (possibly empty) List, so result is never null.
The method dereferences records, so records must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
If records is empty, collectAsList() will produce an empty result list and vice versa.
The resulting List's size from collectAsList() matches the count of records in the HoodieData.
